agency.name: Office of Behavioral Health, Louisiana Department of Health

narrNote: Louisiana does not appear on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, checked 2026-10-22). A state association, the Louisiana Association of Recovery Residences (LARR), operates in Louisiana and is described by third-party sources as a NARR affiliate, but it is not on NARR's official list, so it is not recorded as the affiliate here.
notes: Agency is SAMHSA's Single State Agency for Louisiana (LDH Office of Behavioral Health); phone 225-342-2540 is OBH's published contact on its substance use page. OBH also publishes the Louisiana Substance Use Helpline at 877-664-2248. medicaidSud is null: LDH documents that substance use services are provided through the Medicaid Healthy Louisiana managed-care plans (stated on the verified OBH page), and LDH's official Medicaid Services listing (ldh.la.gov/medicaid/medicaid-services) was identified as the coverage reference, but its direct fetch was blocked by a research-tool rate limit during this run, so no URL is published pending re-verification. County/parish access runs through the 10 Local Governing Entities (human services districts/authorities) covering all 64 parishes for behavioral health and addictive-disorder services. NAMI Louisiana runs peer-led NAMI Connection recovery groups and family support groups statewide.
